# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| importable-flow | Flow export built from the filled `assets/flow-config-contract.md`, deployed on a `test` instance | `deploy-acceptance` | Analyser reports zero blockers; `Set flow config` holds every UUID; SysTime unpack and re-pack pair present; A `catch` reports with the flow name; Output UUID differs from input |
| tab-description-and-flow-documentation | Tab description, named nodes, config contract in the `config flow` comment node | Plant key user, IIAE | The tab says what it produces, for which machine and which use case |
| analyser-result-and-test-evidence | Output of `scripts/analyze_flow.py` plus the `test` run | Human approver (with the IIAE) | Attached to the prod import request |
| findings-and-triage-record-troubleshoot | `assets/triage-record.md`, filled | Plant key user | Cause named as flow, configuration, machine, connector, platform change or ownership; Fix tested on `test`; Plant key user confirmed the values are correct |
| flow-library-entry | Entry for the flow (new, standard or plant-specific) | OD lead | Filed once the flow passes |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| importable-flow | structure of `assets/flow-config-contract.md` | OD lead |
| tab-description-and-flow-documentation | manual | Plant key user |
| analyser-result-and-test-evidence | manual | Human approver (with the IIAE) |
| findings-and-triage-record-troubleshoot | structure of `assets/triage-record.md` | Plant key user |
| flow-library-entry | manual | OD lead |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `ops-event-model`, `mi-signals`, `mi-equipment`, `mi-data-availability`, `deploy-acceptance`
- **Next:** deploy-acceptance (step 3b6); a prod import goes to the human approver.: `deploy-acceptance`
- **Stops here when:** the analyser reports any blocker, or the flow has a hardcoded secret (rotate it)
- **Stops here when:** A prod import needs the human approver
- **Stops here when:** Never change the signal standard or a topic inside a flow
- **Stops here when:** raise it with mi-signals
